name: app_status
description: Snapshot of the running VPuppet app: version, demo state, the model on the stage (name, library id, VRM version, perfect-sync coverage), whether the HOME library screen is showing, tracking mode and state, outputs (VMC, virtual camera) and frame rates. Call this first.

name: library_list
description: List the VRM models in VPuppet's library (most recently used first): id (SHA-256 of the file), display name, author, file name, VRM version, measured stats (perfect-sync count, presets, expressions, spring chains, polygons), import-time model-check warnings, licence badge, and which one is on the stage.

search.description: Only models whose name, author or file name contains this text.

name: library_load
description: Load a library model onto the stage (closes the HOME screen). `id` is the library id from library_list; a unique prefix of 8+ characters is enough. Refused when the Steam demo has ended.

id.description: Library id (or a unique prefix of at least 8 hex characters).

name: library_import
description: Copy a .vrm file into VPuppet's library (measures it, renders a thumbnail, runs the model checks) and optionally load it onto the stage. The library is content-addressed: a re-exported file is a new entry with a new id; importing identical bytes again returns status 'duplicate' with the existing id.

path.description: Absolute path to a .vrm file on this computer.

load.description: Also load it onto the stage (default true).

name: model_inspect
description: Everything VPuppet knows about the model on the stage, for building or debugging an avatar: VRM version and meta, humanoid bones mapped/missing (VRM-required and the ones VPuppet needs), every expression with its bind counts, ARKit perfect-sync coverage (which of the 52 names match using VPuppet's case/punctuation-insensitive matching, which are missing, and missing ones that exist under another naming such as eyeBlink_L), VRM presets present/missing, look-at type, spring bone chains and colliders, mesh/material/texture/polygon stats, licence metadata, and VPuppet's model-check warnings (face backwards, faces away, rest pose, empty expressions).

sections.description: Limit the output to these sections (default: all).

name: stage_screenshot
description: PNG of the stage. `framing` 'current' is exactly what the user sees (their camera, 3D environment included); 'face', 'bust', 'upper' and 'full' frame the avatar from the front with a fixed camera (environment post-processing skipped), without moving the user's camera.

name: expression_set
description: Hold an expression on the avatar at a weight (over tracking) until reset, or reset all held expressions. Names are the model's expression names; ARKit names (eyeBlinkLeft) and VRM presets (happy, aa, blink) also resolve through VPuppet's matching. `exclusive` zeroes every other expression while held, so tracking does not mix in.

reset.description: Release all held expressions (other fields ignored).

name: expression_sweep
description: Drive each expression to 1 in turn (everything else 0, pose frozen) and measure it against a neutral render of the same frame: per expression the bind count, how much of the face changed, which side of the avatar moved (catches swapped Left/Right shapes) and a flag for expressions that bind something but change nothing. Returns those notes plus a labelled contact-sheet PNG (neutral first). Use set='arkit' to verify perfect sync. Pages with offset/limit.

set.description: arkit: the model's matches for the 52 ARKit names. presets: VRM presets. custom: everything else. all: every expression.

names.description: Sweep exactly these instead of a set.

image.description: Include the contact sheet (false: notes only).

name: clip_list
description: List the animation clips (built-in Quaternius UAL / VPuppet clips and the user's imported .fbx/.glb clips): id, label, kind (idle or emote), bone mask, loop, imported, and which are playing.

name: clip_play
description: Play a clip on the avatar over tracking, by id or label (case-insensitive). Playing a looping clip that is already playing stops it. `stop: true` stops all emotes and held hotkey expressions.

clip.description: Clip id or label from clip_list.

name: tracking_stats
description: Webcam tracking health: mode (face/upper/hands), state (TRACKING, LOST, NO HANDS...), per-pipeline fps, latency and inference ms for face/body/hands, where MediaPipe runs (worker/main, GPU/CPU), hand search status per side with found % over the last 3 s, and the current hand gestures.

name: logs_recent
description: Recent status-bar lines, warnings and errors from the app (newest last), with timestamps.

name: settings_get
description: Read the settings this server may change: tracking mode, smoothing, stage framing, background and physics mode, with their allowed values.

name: settings_set
description: Change any of: tracking mode, smoothing, stage framing, background (solid colour, transparent or the 3D environment) and physics mode. Applied live and saved like a change in the UI. Returns the new values.

mode.description: face: head and expressions only; upper: plus torso and arms; hands: plus fingers.

smoothing.description: Higher is steadier with more lag (default 0.5).
